title: Condo & High-Rise Moving in Addis Ababa: Permit, Elevator & Security Checklist
excerpt: Condo move Addis Ababa checklist: building permits, service lift booking, security clearance, and truck timing so moving day is not blocked at the gate.
content:
Condo and high-rise moving in Addis Ababa

Most apartment moves in Addis Ababa happen in condominiums and high-rises. Delays usually come from paperwork and lift scheduling—not from packing. Active Movers coordinates with building management before moving day so your crew is not turned away at the gate.

Before you book a date

  • Ask management for written move rules: allowed days, hours, and whether a service/freight lift is required.
  • Confirm truck access: gate width, one-way streets, and where the vehicle may idle during loading.
  • Reserve the service lift (many buildings need 24–48 hours notice; peak end-of-month dates fill fast).
  • Collect any move permit, security clearance, or insurance proof the association requires.
  • Measure lift interior dimensions if you have large wardrobes, refrigerators, or sofas—plan partial disassembly if needed.

Moving day in the building

Use padding on lifts and common areas where required. Keep passenger lifts for residents when the building restricts furniture in them. Stagger heavy items with the elevator time slot so you do not lose your window.

Truck timing on Addis roads

Freight vehicles may face city time restrictions and permit requirements. Plan loading outside peak traffic when possible, and confirm whether your route needs a freight movement permit from the Addis Ababa Traffic Management Authority for the day of your move.

Move-out handover photos

Photograph walls, floors, and meter readings before furniture leaves and again after unload at the new unit. Disputes with landlords and associations rely on timestamps—pair with our move-out checklist.

End-of-month competition

Two households in one tower fighting the same weekend elevator slot is the top condo failure mode. Book freight in the first week you know your date—end-of-month rush. Neighbors can coordinate one vendor—group move tips.

Imported furniture

Measure lift doors against wardrobe depth; plan disassembly before move day—cam-lock wardrobe guide. Refrigerators may need extra crew and lift padding.

Security ID lists

Submit truck plate, driver name, and crew count 24–48 hours ahead when management requires it. Active Movers confirms plate by SMS the day before load.
